thread:
jen: FYI vendor invoice for BetaCorp shows two PDFs with different totals. System created INV-BETA-2026-04-112 and INV-BETA-2026-04-112-duplicate. One is missing the tiered-usage line items.

liam: Oof. Which batch?

jen: billing-run-20260415-09. billing-bot shows: job completed but postprocess emitted duplicate invoice id when reissue flag set.

billing-bot: Notice: run=billing-run-20260415-09 step=postprocess event=warning code=duplicate_invoice_id detected invoice_id collision for INV-BETA-2026-04-112. auto-reissue=true.

arjun: Do we have the two payloads? Can someone paste the line items?

jen: Pasting minimal diffs.

jen: ORIGINAL (INV-BETA-2026-04-112):
```json
[
  {"code":"subscription","amount":"500.00"},
  {"code":"support","amount":"100.00"},
  {"code":"tiered_usage","amount":"1800.00","details":"500k tokens @ tier2"}
]
```

jen: DUPLICATE (INV-BETA-2026-04-112-duplicate):
```json
[
  {"code":"subscription","amount":"500.00"},
  {"code":"support","amount":"100.00"}
]
```

liam: Looks like the duplicate dropped the tiered_usage lines. Total is off by 1800.00. Could be a partial re-emit when retrying the postprocess step.

arjun: Is there any customer charge already attempted against the duplicate PDF? Payment-state?

jen: Payment not captured yet. Status: drafted. Good. But accounting export already picked up both and shows doubled revenue in our draft revenue reports.

liam: Important: don't mark invoiced/paid for either until we resolve. Set invoice flag: hold-for-review.

jen: Done. Command: `/billing set-flag INV-BETA-2026-04-112 hold-for-review --reason "duplicate missing tiered_usage"`

billing-bot: Flag set on INV-BETA-2026-04-112: hold-for-review.

arjun: Root cause hypothesis: postprocess reissue path uses a different line-emitter instance that doesn't pull usage slices when reissue=true. Also missing idempotency check on invoice_id collision. I'll open an incident.

liam: For remediation: 1) remove the duplicate draft invoice 2) regenerate corrected invoice with full lines 3) reconcile accounting draft export to remove the doubled revenue entry 4) add a validation gate that ensures tiered_usage lines are present for customers with usage > threshold.

jen: I'll delete the duplicate draft now and regenerate.

jen: Deleted INV-BETA-2026-04-112-duplicate. Command output: "deleted draft invoice INV-BETA-2026-04-112-duplicate"

jen: Regenerating INV-BETA-2026-04-112 with full lines, creating reissue INV-BETA-2026-04-112-v2 that replaces the original and references the deletion of the duplicate.

billing-bot: Manual reissue created INV-BETA-2026-04-112-v2 replaces INV-BETA-2026-04-112.

arjun: Opening incident INC-2026-04-BILL-07 and assigning to eng-billing + eng-runtime. Notes: "postprocess reissue path omitted usage slices; invoice_id collision allowed duplicate drafts; accounting export must ignore drafts flagged hold-for-review."

liam: Also request product to approve messaging for BetaCorp. CC @acct-team.

jen: Notifying account team: "We found duplicate draft invoice for April. We're issuing corrected invoice INV-BETA-2026-04-112-v2 and voided duplicate draft. No payment was captured. We'll send a confirmation when done."

billing-bot: Accounting export rolled back to exclude both invoices from today's draft export.

arjun: Created PR to add validation and idempotency: #2486. Tests included to assert tiered_usage present when usage>0 and to block duplicate invoice ids. Target: staging deploy tomorrow.

liam: Thanks team. Keep this thread updated when PR merges and accounting export shows clean.

jen: Will update. Closing loop once we have staging deploy and clean export. :thumbsup:
